faqs.q: How long does it take to get a response?
faqs.a: We respond to all queries within 24 hours.

faqs.q: How can I apply for admission?
faqs.a: Visit our website and fill the online application form under the Admissions section.

faqs.q: Can I visit the campus before admission?
faqs.a: Yes, you can book a campus visit through our website or call our admissions helpline.
